in_marathi.name: Parvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parvansh means 'supreme power' in Sanskrit. It is derived from two Sanskrit words - Parvat (mountain) and Vansh (lineage). According to mythology, Parvansh is the name of the Lord Shiva and the name of a sage.
